events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Brandon Valenzuela hit a go-ahead RBI double off Aroldis Chapman with two outs in the ninth inning and the Toronto Blue Jays completed a three-game sweep of the Boston Red Sox with a 4-3 win Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: After a misplayed foul pop, Valenzuela hits go-ahead double in Blue Jays' 4-3 win over Red Sox

headlines.description: — Travis Bazzana hit a go-ahead solo homer in the seventh inning, Parker Messick pitched six effective innings and the Cleveland Guardians beat the Milwaukee Brewers 4-2 on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bazzana’s 7th-inning homer helps lift Guardians past Brewers 4-2

headlines.description: — Brooks Lee hit a three-run homer as Minnesota scored multiple runs in the first inning for the third consecutive game, and the Twins went on to complete a series sweep of the Texas Rangers with a 9-3 win Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Twins have another crooked-number 1st inning to complete 3-game sweep at Texas with 9-3 win

headlines.description: — Bryan Woo pitched seven shutout innings, Colt Emerson drove in two of Seattle’s three first-inning runs and the Mariners beat the Baltimore Orioles 3-0 on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bryan Woo throws 7 scoreless innings as the Mariners beat the Orioles 3-0

events.name: New York Mets at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Juan Soto hit two solo homers and made a sliding catch in the left-field corner to rob Bryce Harper of a run-scoring hit as the New York Mets defeated the Philadelphia Phillies 6-4 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Juan Soto homers twice to lead the Mets to a 6-4 win over the Phillies

events.name: Chicago White Sox at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Andrew Benintendi launched a pinch-hit grand slam off Camilo Doval in the eighth inning Thursday night and the Chicago White Sox ended a nine-game losing streak at Yankee Stadium with a 5-1 victory over New York.
headlines.shortLinkText: Benintendi's pinch-hit grand slam helps White Sox stop 9-game skid in Bronx with 5-1 win over Yanks

St. Louis Cardinals at Kansas City Royals

headlines.shortLinkText: Bobby Witt Jr. homers before leaving with knee injury in Royals' 14-6 win over Cardinals

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — Gage Jump gave up one hit over seven sparkling innings, and Shea Langeliers and Tyler Soderstrom hit back-to-back homers in a five-run first that sent the Athletics to a 5-0 victory over the Los Angeles Angels on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gage Jump spins gem and A's score 5 in 1st to beat Angels 5-0 after Trout lands on injured list
